summary.text: Paul Dyson is a Republican state representative and lawyer who has represented Texas House District 14 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Paul Dyson earned a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University in 2002 and a law degree from South Texas College of Law in 2007.
His career experience includes working as a lawyer.
Dyson succeeded John Raney in representing District 14 and assumed office on January 14, 2025.
He advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary; Janet Dudding and Jeff Miller are also listed in the 2026 general election.
